author: KEXP
description: Los Angeles-born artist zzzahara offers shimmering soundscapes dipped in lo-fi, dream pop and slowcore in our latest in-studio session. Live on KEXP with host Troy Nelson, they share a performance of "On Fye" and more.
title: zzzahara performs "On Fye" & more Live on KEXP
